# Admin guide

This guide explains how admins manage users, storage and sync schedules in Acme Sync.

## Sync schedule

The sync engine checks the
folder list every five minutes and uploads changes as it finds them. The following settings control the job:

| Setting | Default | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Check interval | 5 minutes | 1 to 60 minutes |
| Upload threads | 4 | 1 to 16 |

| Bandwidth limit | none | 50 KB/s to 100 MB/s |
| Retry delay | 30 seconds | 5 to 300 seconds |

## Restore a user's files

Run the restore command on the admin workstation:

```bash
acme-sync admin restore --user jane.doe@example.com --since 2026-01-01

metadata.title: Admin guide

text:
--dry-run
```

The command lists the files first. Remove --dry-run to restore them.

## Transfer a user's files

1. Open Users and select the user.
2. Choose Transfer and pick the new owner.

metadata.title: Admin guide
metadata.heading_path: Admin guide > Transfer a user's files

text:
3. Confirm the new owner in the Users list.
4. Ask the user to sign out and sign in again.
